goal: lift data sufficiency to FULL-FINETUNE-CANDIDATE (final finetune only)

sessions.reason: single session uses one shared LO/SDR/temperature state; splitting within a session leaks that state across train/val/test

source_waveforms.requirement: each of the 24 classes gets >=20 DISTINCT source realizations (distinct symbol sequences / seeds), not the same 24 bursts repeated across sessions
source_waveforms.forbidden: re-using the current 24 tx_package source waveforms as the only realizations (they are already consumed as the 2-session audit set)

capture_contract.forced_export: gate-rejected frames MUST still export recovered tensor + frozen-model logits (diagnostic bypass), never dropped
capture_contract.no_label_driven_selection: recovery / DC / scale params chosen WITHOUT using labels or per-sample source identity

leakage_controls.split_unit: SESSION (a whole session goes to exactly one of train/val/test)
leakage_controls.no_realization_duplication: a source realization may not appear in more than one session split
leakage_controls.no_gate_exclusion: all 24 classes stay in the 24 denominator; no dropping of gate-rejected / wrong / non-finite samples

stop_conditions.proceed_to_final_finetune: >=5 sessions captured, >=20 realizations/class, residual distribution passes recovery gate at a rate making finetune meaningful (else fix RX first)
stop_conditions.do_not_finetune_until: receive-chain residual no longer systematically exceeds the 0.100 gate (finetuning on residual-limited recoveries reinforces the RX distortion)
stop_conditions.authorization_required: training/finetuning requires explicit user authorization; the standing red line is 不训练
